messages.subject: seq in mirt.model
parts:
Hi every one

 I want my 'mirt model' specification works based on number of items that change based on some conditions. Can anyone help me about my specification for mirt model?

nitem=15
mod <- mirt.model('
F1 = 1-nitem
F2 = (nitem+1)-(2*nitem))
COV = F1*F2'

messages.subject: Re: seq in mirt.model
parts:
Thanks
Hear is my solution based on your recommendation.

nitem=15
nitem1=nitem+1
nitem2=2*nitem
string <-  sprintf('F1=1-%i 
                           F2=%i-%i 
                           COV=F1*F2',nitem,nitem1,nitem2)
mod <-mirt.model(string)
